steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Bao Thuy, a water element bubble creature, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: floating down to the food; (3) EAT: engulfing it in a bubble; (4) EAT: the food floating inside it. Row 2: (5) EAT: blowing little bubbles happily; (6) PLAY: bobbing up and down; (7) PLAY: blowing a big bubble; (8) PLAY: riding the big bubble high. Row 3: (9) PLAY: bouncing off the bubble, spinning; (10) PLAY: the bubble pops and it drops down; (11) PLAY: cheering surrounded by bubbles; (12) REFUSE food: hiding inside a bubble. Row 4: (13) PETTED: wobbling and glowing, eyes closed; (14) WAVE hello: waving a little water arm; (15) SAD: deflated and droopy; (16) ANGRY: puffed up, bubbles bursting.
